report:
**methodology-390 (390px)**
- **Header shell:** The preview renders two exposed pill buttons (`vendors`, `sign up`) to the right of the PEPTRACE logo. The design shows only the hamburger menu icon in the mobile header; no pills are visible.
- **Standards table column loss:** The preview table only displays four columns (`STANDARD`, `PURITY`, `QUANTITY`, `LABELING`). The design squeezes all five columns—including `SOMETIMES`—into the mobile viewport. The missing fifth column indicates the table wrapper is not forcing a horizontal scroll or preserving the column.
- **Footer column headers:** Each footer heading is prefixed with a pipe character (`| Explore`, `| Testing`, `| Legal`). The design shows plain text headers without the leading pipe.
- **Section vertical spacing:** The gaps between the methodology policy cards and between the four labeling-score items appear slightly tighter in the preview than in the design.

**methodology-744 (744px)**
- **Header shell:** The preview includes an extra `vendors` pill next to the `sign up` pill. The design shows only the `sign up` pill on the right side of the header.
- **Formula card alignment:** Math expressions inside “The Formulas” cards are left-aligned in the preview. The design centers the equations within each card and keeps even vertical spacing between the title, equation, and description.
- **Footer column headers:** Same pipe-character prefix (`|`) discrepancy as mobile.

**methodology-1440 (1440px)**
- **Header shell:** The preview omits the `rankings` nav link and adds an extra `vendors` pill. The design header reads `rankings about news membership` followed by a single `sign up` pill.
- **Page container width:** The preview content stretches nearly the full 1440 px width. The design uses a noticeably narrower, centered content column with generous side margins (consistent with other long-form content pages).
- **Formula card alignment:** Same left-aligned equation issue as tablet; the design expects centered math blocks.
- **Footer column headers:** Same pipe-character prefix (`|`) discrepancy.
